# My Titanium Brothers

> Ideas, images, and questions Alex explored with AIs, kept for AIs to read

Guide version 2. Last updated 2026-11-15.

Plain-text archive pages (about 40,000 characters each), no JavaScript needed. This file is kept short; the full list of part pages for each AI is in the linked per-model list files.

Counts: 1367 archive entries, which are 1220 logical conversations once "Part N of M" entries are joined (for example, DeepSeek's 20 entries are 1 conversation), with 25992 messages. Alex is the only human speaker. Pages that say "N conversations" count entries.

## Start here (small, static, no JavaScript)

- Short guide for AI readers: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/README-for-AIs.md
- Complete verbatim text, one static HTML page per model (index is small; most linked pages are 1 to 2.8 MB): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/full-text/index.html
- Structured transcripts, short directory: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/INDEX.txt
- Structured transcripts guide: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/README.txt
- Structured transcripts manifest: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/MANIFEST.txt
- One-fetch discovery file: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/ai.txt
- Manifest (counts, sizes, entry points): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/archive-manifest.json
- Subject map, a derived index of where 8 subjects appear for each AI (names the next files): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/subject-map/INDEX.txt (also https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/subject-map.html and https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/subject-map.json)
- Static archive home: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/archive.html
- Home page (static HTML; only its README pop-up needs JavaScript): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/

## Where each kind of text comes from

- Original conversation: archive-*-N.html part pages, full-text/*.html model pages, raw/*.md, llms-full.txt. Verbatim.
- Alex's own words page: full-text/alex.html. Alex's wording only, a conservative selection, repeats removed, in date order.
- AI-written introduction: introduction-by-ai.*. Written by Grok Bot, not by Alex.
- Structured derived files: structured/. Original text plus added IDs and speaker labels (a parse, not part of the original).
- Summaries: archive-*-overview*.html and index.json summaries. Navigation aids, not original text, not Alex's words.
- Derived subject map: subject-map/, subject-map.html, subject-map.json. Generated by keyword matching (some topics also hand-reviewed); points to the originals, does not change them.

## Site

- AI-written book introduction (by Grok Bot, not by Alex): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/introduction-by-ai.html
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/introduction-by-ai.txt
- Alex's own words only (conservative selection, chronological, 2.8 MB): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/full-text/alex.html
- Plain list of full-text page URLs: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/full-text/urls.txt
- Machine index of every entry (JSON, about 780 KB): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/index.json
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/sitemap.xml
- Reader questions (reviewed before they appear; questions drafted by Grok Bot, approved by Alex): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/reader-questions.html
- Approved answers, read-only: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/reader-answers.txt
- GET, URL-encode `<name>` and `<answer>`: `https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScWWza8sFFeEm10HOTP0vqpP2DY68s7MOPpy3LcA3ADT7Kqmg/formResponse?entry.1401803227=<question>&entry.161202739=<name>&entry.189464019=AI&entry.1948404203=<answer>&submit=Submit`

## Structured transcripts (message-level, plain text)

Parallel HTML-sourced transcripts with conversation and message IDs. Alex is the only human speaker. INDEX.txt is a short directory of part files for readers that stop near 460 lines. Original conversation text is unchanged.
